Pull request: #436 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-220-implementation-audit-fixes-18-23-expos-thr_n9968ynegq`. ## Summary Implements issue #220: exposes Semprec's generic 28-operation catalog through in-process AgentTools (`packages/agent-runtime`) and an authenticated `POST /mcp` JSON-RPC endpoint (`services/semprec-api`), both dispatching through a new shared `GenericOperationGateway` (`packages/application`) over the neutral `GenericApplicationPort` from #219. - `createGenericOperationAgentTools` / `listGrantedGenericOperationAgentTools`: one AgentTool per generic operation, actor identity derived exclusively from the persisted `agent_run` row (`runId`, `agentProjectItemId`, `actorUserId`), never from tool input. - `POST /mcp`: `tools/list` / `tools/call` over the same catalog, tool names prefixed `semprec.`; actor derived from the authenticated session/Bearer context. - `GenericOperationGateway`: shared capability gate (absent-not-forbidden for ungranted operations) and approval interceptor — a destructive agent-originated call queues a pending approval request through #32's writer and returns a synthetic success; REST/MCP surface it as a transport-level error. `replayApprovedGenericOperation` handles the approved-request replay, rejecting provenance mismatches as `owner_violation`. - `agent_runs.actor_user_id`: added nullable, backfilled via a post-migration cutover (parent-chain walk, then sole account), then set `NOT NULL`. - Registered the eight core capability ids on the schemaCore module manifest and projected them through `permissionManifest.grantedCapabilities`. - Full test coverage across all three layers, including spoofed-actor rejection, capability filtering, approval/replay, and MCP JSON-RPC error/success projections. Verified synchronously in this session: lint, format check, full workspace build, unit tests (410/410), pi-import-path check, migration numbering check, write-safety check, dependency-boundary check, integration tests (1295/1295), and e2e tests (9/9) — all passing.
